Twenty-three comments

This is one of two Maire Breathnach compositions going by the name of Branohm, requested by a certain heavy nettle band in Discussions. I’m just about to post the other one.

I should say that I got this tune out of an abc collection and I suspect the bar lines may be in the wrong places. But I don’t know the tune very well - I last heard it about 3 years ago on a Solas album - so I have left it as it is. If anyone can confirm that it is wrong, I’ll put it right. The notes all sound right to me, anyway

↳ Posted by CreadurMawnOrganig on January 13th, 2002.

David, this tune too is on Solas’ cd “Solas,” listed as “Maire Breathnach’s #2” in track 8.

↳ Posted by Will Harmon on January 13th, 2002.

Now that I listen to it, I can see that your abc source has the bar lines in the wrong place. The tune as played by Solas’ Win Horan on fiddle starts:
|e(3AAA cdec|d2 gd BAGB|A~E3 ABcd|(3efg fa geag| and so on

Great tune though. :-)

↳ Posted by Will Harmon on January 13th, 2002.

P.S. Win starts off the B Part a little different from the version you have, probably to avoid that “edef” string crossing at the breakneck speed they’re playing this at on the cd. She does:

|[eA2] ef gfaf|gedc Bedg|
and then it looks pretty much the same as what you’ve got.

↳ Posted by Will Harmon on January 13th, 2002.

um, er, that’d be |gedc Bcdg| in the above second bar. This tune is fated to by typed in with errors…. I look forward to your clearing it up on the next go round,
Will

↳ Posted by Will Harmon on January 13th, 2002.

Bar lines

Thanks, Will, for confirming that. I’ll try and put that right.

Like I said, I got this version from an existing abc collection. It was transcribed from Maire Breathnach’s own recording, so it is (assuming it is accurately transcribed, which is probably not a safe assumption, given the bar line error) the “original” version.

↳ Posted by CreadurMawnOrganig on January 14th, 2002.

Máire Breatnach is an Irish fiddle, violin and viola player.
Not to be confused with Maire Breathnach, Irish actress.
